newsitem.title: USA: SoftNet Systems makes management changes.
newsitem.headline: SoftNet Systems makes management changes.

text.p: SoftNet Systems Inc said on Thursday that chairman John McDonough assumed the additional role of chief executive officer, replacing John Jellinek, who was named vice chairman.
In addition, A.J.R. Oosthuizen was promoted to president and chief operating officer for the company from president of the company's document management division.
SoftNet develops, markets and installs electronic information and document management systems that allow customers to electronically request and retrieve data.
